description: This header file declares the interface for a COSA plugin, including initialization, support query, and unloading functions. It serves as an external API for the plugin module in a C project.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA plugin with a maximum supported version and plugin info pointer.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks whether a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin resources.
